The '''1919 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship''' was the 33rd staging of the [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]], the [[Gaelic Athletic Association]]'s premier [[inter county|inter-county]] [[hurling]] tournament. The championship ran from 18 May to 21 September 1919.

[[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] were the [[1918 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|defending champions]], however, they were beaten by [[Cork GAA|Cork]] in the [[#Munster final|Munster final]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.gaa.ie/centenary/match-reports/1918-match-report-all-ireland-hurling-final|title=1918 GAA Hurling Final Match Report|publisher=GAA website|accessdate=4 October 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.limerickleader.ie/sport/relatives-sought-for-re-enactment-of-limericks-1918-all-ireland-hurling-final-win-8320894|title=Relatives sought for re-enactment of Limerick's 1918 All Ireland hurling final win|publisher=Limerick Live|date=25 May 2018|accessdate=4 October 2026}}</ref>

The [[#All-Ireland final|All-Ireland final]] was played at [[Croke Park]] in [[Dublin]] on 21 September 1919 between [[Cork GAA|Cork]] and [[Dublin GAA|Dublin]], in what was their [[Cork–Dublin hurling rivalry#All-time results|fourth championship meeting overall]] and a first meeting in the All-Ireland final in [[1894 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship final|25 years]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.dublingaa.ie/news/recent-meetings-dublin-v-cork-hurling|title=Recent meetings: Dublin v Cork (hurling)|publisher=Dublin GAA website|date=29 July 2021|accessdate=17 October 2026}}</ref> Cork won the match by 6–04 to 2–04 to claim their seventh All-Ireland title overall and a first title in [[1903 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|sixteen years]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.rte.ie/centuryireland/articles/cork-defeat-dublin-in-all-ireland-hurling-decider|title=Cork defeat Dublin in All-Ireland hurling decider|publisher=Century Ireland|date=|accessdate=17 October 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.independent.ie/sport/gaa/hurling/not-since-1903-1919-have-cork-gone-so-long-without-a-hurling-all-ireland-has-their-time-come-again/a/135905739.html|title=Not since 1903-1919 have Cork gone so long without a hurling All-Ireland, has their time come again?|publisher=Irish Independent|date=28 July 2018|accessdate=17 October 2026}}</ref>
